scientific_integrity: The stated equality is modulo compact operators. Essential spectral consequences use standard continuous-symbol Hardy Toeplitz theory. Symbolic and numerical checks are supporting, not substitutes for the infinite analytical proof. Independent mathematical audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The compact-equivalence classification is proved for continuous angular profiles, nonzero fixed chirp coefficient and positive chirp exponent. Full point spectra, uniform rates in the exponent near one, and discontinuous profiles are not addressed. Historical priority is provisional pending broader pseudodifferential and limit-operator coverage.
title: Critical angular-chirp smoothing of Gaussian Fock localization
